Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> If I only have Mata Hari in play, am I able to play Terra Incognita?

Mata Hari can play Terra Incognita as a Laibon, yes. If she does, then she is
not a "non-Laibon", so doesn't run afoul of that restriction.

Messages.Author: J
Messages.Body:
> If I only have Mata Hari in play, am I able to play Terra Incognita?

I'd say yes... but IANLSJ

Relevant text:
Mata Hari: You and she may play cards that require a sect and/or clan
as if she were of that required sect or clan.
Terra Incognito: Requires a ready Laibon. Not usable if you control
any ready non-Laibon vampires.

Whilst playing the card, Mata is treated as Laibon. Which means if
you only control Mata and no other vamps, I'd assume that game state
would see you with 1 Ready Laibon and 0 ready non-Laibon.

Of course, you know what they say about assumptions.

And it's still wrong, and not moot.

That card will see her as a Laibon etc. The rest of the game state will
not.

For example, while playing that card, it is important that the rest of
the game state does *not* see her as a Laibon if she has become an
Anarch. If the rest of the game state saw her as Laibon, it would have
to note a sect change and revoke her Anarch status. However, since it
is only that card that sees what it sees, there is no problem.
